title: Time to origin
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the time for ball A to reach O using kinematics under constant acceleration.

title: Velocity before collision
description: Essential: Correctly calculates ball A's speed at O using kinematics or work-energy.

title: Post-collision velocity
description: Important: Applies momentum conservation to find the speed of combined object D.

title: Magnetic field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates B using Lorentz force and centripetal force for D's circular motion.

title: Magnetic field direction
description: Important: Correctly determines the magnetic field direction using the left-hand rule.

title: Second y-axis velocity
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the speed of D when it crosses the y-axis a second time.

title: Second y-axis position
description: Essential: Correctly determines the coordinates where D crosses the y-axis a second time.

title: Geometry and kinematics
description: Important: Correctly relates given displacements and angles to motion parameters.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in vector components or reports an answer with incorrect units.

title: Force law misapplication
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly applies Lorentz force (e.g., wrong charge, mass, or radius) or Newton's second law.
